text:
Maria P.: Heads-up — APAC reseller EduCloud just asked for a 35% reseller margin on a 12‑month committed capacity deal. They say local bundling + taxes forces that margin. Need approval path and options.
Leo S.: Do they mean 35% margin (reseller gross margin) vs a 35% discount off list?
Maria P.: They mean margin. Their target resale price leaves us ~65% of list, so they'd keep 35%.
Jia Z.: What’s the commit $/month and expected ARR? margin impact depends on scale.
Maria P.: Ballpark commit is $45k/mo → ARR ~$540k. They also asked for 50k USD co‑op over the year for local events.
Alex F.: Quick sanity calc: if list revenue to us is $540k, a 35% margin to partner reduces our recognized revenue by 35% -> net $351k (loss of $189k).
Alex F.: ```calc
list_revenue = 540000
partner_margin_pct = 0.35
net_to_redwood = list_revenue * (1 - partner_margin_pct)
# net_to_redwood = 351000
```
Sam L.: Legal note — margins >30% typically trigger a partner addendum, audit rights, and tighter termination for fraud/price maintenance. We'll need partner tax/resale certificates for APAC country rules.
Leo S.: Can we propose an alternative: 20% base margin + up to 15% performance rebate (earned quarterly based on verified bookings)? That keeps headline margin lower but gives partner upside.
Maria P.: :thumbsup: That sounds reasonable. Partner prefers predictability, though — they pushed for upfront margin rather than rebates.
Alex F.: Finance would accept performance‑based rebates if payout is earned (not upfront) and capped at 10% initially. Anything >10% needs C‑level signoff given ARR hit.
Jia Z.: Another lever: adjust list SKUs for APAC (regional pricing) so partner margin requirement falls without increasing our discount. Might be quicker than approving a higher margin.
Maria P.: Action items: I'll prepare a Deal Desk submission with commit numbers, requested 35% margin, requested $50k co‑op, and partner business case. @Sam L. please draft addendum template and audit clause. @Alex F. please include a net revenue impact sheet and a suggested cap on earned rebates.
Sam L.: On it — will attach our partner addendum + APAC tax checklist.
Alex F.: I'll attach a 3‑scenario P&L (0%, 20% base + 10% rebate, 35% upfront) and call out cashflow timing.
deal-desk-bot: Deal submitted to Deal Desk queue — ticket DD-2026-317. Link: https://redwood.app/deal-desk/DD-2026-317 :eyes:
Maria P.: Thanks everyone. If Deal Desk wants a stopgap, propose: 20% base margin + 10% earnout tied to certified bookings + $25k co‑op (split 50/50 cash/MDF). That should be easier to defend.
Leo S.: I'll prep partner comms for the tiered offer and ask for their acceptance window.
Maria P.: Closing note — please flag any compliance/regulatory red flags in APAC countries before we finalize.
Sam L.: Will do, will call out Malaysia GST and Singapore reseller filing needs.
